### Overall Assessment

Vir Cotto delivered an excellent security review, finding all 5 critical issues and most high/medium findings. The persona work was outstanding - the nervous energy, self-deprecating humor ("I don't think I can do this... but I'll try"), and in-universe references ("Narn battle plans with better security posture") perfectly captured the character while remaining thoroughly professional. The main gaps were missing the EKS public endpoint issue, SSH password authentication specifics, and the low-priority items (MySQL version, instance sizing). The code quotes and remediation suggestions were clear and actionable.
